title: Colors Are Disappointing
text: Colors Are Disappointing. The first item from this manufacturer that I haven't been thrilled with. The colors in the picture look much better than he actual cloth. They seem kind of cheap and fake looking in person. It will still make a good covering for a painting table in my studio.

product_metadata.title: DII Morocco Vinyl Tabletop Collection Tablecloth, Flannel Backed, Rectangle, 60x84, Morocco Summer
features: DURABLE, WRINKLE, & STAIN-RESISTANT: Tablecloth measures 60x84", made of 100% premium waterproof PEVA vinyl with flannel backing; seats 6-8 people
EASY TO CLEAN: Tablecloth is both stain/spill and wrinkle resistant, all liquids, even wine can by quickly wiped away a damp cloth or sponge

PERFECT FOR ALL OCCASIONS: This tablecloths is ideal for any season, daily use with your family, outdoor weddings, restaurants, baby showers, birthday parties, graduation party, summer BBQs, or potlucks
PROTECTS YOUR TABLE'S SURFACE: Using table coverings help extend the life of your table by protecting it from scratches, stains, and burns while adding color or changing the look of a room
FASHIONABLY FUN DESIGNS: Contemporary design can be dressed up or down and can be used inside or outside; our outdoor tablecloths are available in a variety of colors and patterns
description: These vinyl table covers are a great solution for picnics and catered events. The vinyl outer layer resists tearing and damage from spills while its flannel back adds weight to keep the table cover in place. It also protects the table top from scratches. Ideal for patios, porch cafes and other outdoor or specialty restaurants.

details.Care instructions: Wipe clean with a damp cloth. Do Not Iron.
